title: SCFA Production & Signalling
mission: Maintain short-chain fatty acid production and signalling that supports gut barrier and brain communication.
stage2a: bounded source adjudication complete; material issues recorded

checks.detail: Generic resistant-starch composition must not be presented as supply of the specific potato-RS2 intervention.
The source assessment must preserve the sampled-site null and distinguish SCFA infusion from substrate conversion.
Pascale is review-level evidence, not independent primary cellular replication.
Target-scoped food research recovers credible apple pectin composition without writing a canonical edge.
Existing verified class-level edges remain recognised; trial matching is a different question.
A researched prospective input is not automatically admitted into the unchanged PM.

scope: Scoped research/adjudication test only. Canonical decisions, PM source, food records, registry, governance and scores remain unchanged.
